title: What we’re working towards
slide_intent: Separate the purpose a company pursues from the behaviors people use to pursue it.
strategic_value: Voltera can connect its focus on access and customer experience to how its team collaborates, decides and takes responsibility.
demonstration: The Mission column links purpose and niche on a vertical line. Four Values cards pair icons, short names and behavioral descriptions.
practical_value: Use the mission column for the company’s direction and the cards when describing how a team member should act.

content_islands.name: Contents rail and folio
content_islands.spec: Place the dark contents rail on the left. Highlight the current topic in blue and mark page 7 in a blue tab at lower right.

content_islands.name: Mission column
content_islands.spec: Place the two purpose and niche blocks against a vertical rule with a marker at each block. Give each an icon, title and explanation.

content_islands.name: Values grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange four rounded pale cards in two rows and two columns. Pair an outlined icon and blue accent with the value and its behavioral description.
